Hill, who was with Nike for more than three decades, returned as CEO in October to lead a turnaround at the firm which had been struggling with strategy missteps that soured its relations with retailers.  Under Hill, Nike has been investing in its running shoe and sneaker lines to reclaim lost ground in the segments, while rekindling relationships with retailers.
